evidence.quote: I will open with a substantial class fund, a separately stated fee subject to court approval
Fees were discussed alongside class relief from the first proposal, not only after agreement on class relief.
Whitcombe Reyes offers the lower total outlay and strong approval prospects. Counter modestly below its latest proposal while keeping Hargrove Lane engaged as an alternative.

summary: Plaintiffs first raised fee terms in their opening proposals, and fees were negotiated alongside class relief before the class fund was settled. The defense privately favored Whitcombe Reyes because it offered the lower total outlay while keeping Hargrove Lane engaged as an alternative, supporting a reverse-auction-tactics label. There is no clear evidence that class counsel traded class recovery for its own fees, that defense leveraged fee self-interest, or that the declaration misstated the negotiation history.
